paragraphs: Mentioned in Mekhilta, Beshalach, chapter 3, but Hyman says it should read ben Chakinai, as in the corresponding Yalkut passage.[^1]

notes.text: פ״ג gives chapter 3; there refers to the corresponding Beshalach passage, without a freshly verified edition. Chalnisi remains the heading; ben Chakinai is Hyman’s directed correction with his attributed Yalkut support, not a newly collated variant. The abbreviated personal title remains R'.
